[2] dodging just one nail almost cuts his most important damage source in half.
[2] Whilst ritual nail is down, you have an opportunity to trade with him where his options for retaliation are severely limited.

[2] Good Lock players start team fights with their ult because it slows you enough to land ritual nails, which is what he needs to actually kill you. So being able to dash out of it makes his kill condition much more difficult.
[2] There's absolutely no benefit to standing in or near the wave because his nails pass through units, and doing so means he gets to clear the wave as he sets up a trade
[2] You want to stand away from the minions so he has to choose between trading and farming.
[2] he also has to precariously put himself in melee range to do so.
